# atlassian_jira_webhook (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a Jira Cloud administrator webhook by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_jira_webhook" "collector" {
  id = "7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the webhook.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger the webhook.
- `exclude_body` (Boolean) Whether the issue body is excluded from deliveries.
- `is_signed` (Boolean) Whether a secret is configured.
- `jql` (String) JQL filter for issue-related events.
- `name` (String) The name of the webhook.
- `url` (String) The URL Jira posts events to.
